verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform documents its own Sandbox environment for sending test data, with a sandbox, then demo, then production-key progression for the Case Status and FOIA APIs. This directly supports the core of the story, but sandbox access sits behind developer-account onboarding and team registration. The docs also do not show that the sandbox mirrors the full production rail end to end. missing for 10: sandbox details (endpoints, test fixtures, behavior parity with production), evidence that all API flows can be exercised end to end in the sandbox, openly public access without onboarding gates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production

citations.quote: Gain Access and develop in our Sandbox environment to send test data.
Pass the demo and receive production keys to launch your application.
with developer accounts, API keys, and a sandbox
